framing.note: The approved composition enters from the left edge by design. No rescale and no offset: the head, the beak and the small fish keep their approved pixels, and the left rounded corners cut the hood exactly as the owner accepted it. Clearance is measured and recorded rather than enforced as a centred-object inset.

matte.calibrationNote: The native matte is 250-252 with faint coloured ringing. Ivory face, throat and chest reach 249 in the brightest planes, so the matte is separated by connectivity, not by a global white test: a 244 minimum-channel exterior flood fill stops at the low-value rim that surrounds every pale area. The chest ends in a 148-value edge, the face in a 83-141 rim, and the fish outline encloses itself. Enclosed white eye highlights stay opaque.
matte.backgroundSeedReason: No interior background seeds. Every enclosed near-white region is an eye highlight or a pale plane inside the bird, protected by connectivity.
matte.componentCleanupReason: Isolated components below 100 native pixels are exterior matte and antialias residue. The bird and the fish it holds stay one connected assembly.

pattern.name: Aphotic depth lines
pattern.description: Horizon lines sink and compress toward the bottom right, with short depth ticks in the open field. The lines read as a descent through water rather than a sightline across it, and they stay out of the open area beside the face.

background.status: Designed local presentation, separate from the source website palette.
